verses.text: 'Do not let your heart be troubled; believe in God, believe also in Me.
verses.textZh: 你們心裡不要憂愁；你們信神，也當信我。

verses.text: 'In My Father's house are many dwelling places; if it were not so, I would have told you; for I go to prepare a place for you.
verses.textZh: 在我父的家裡有許多住處；若是沒有，我就早已告訴你們了。我去原是為你們預備地方去。

verses.text: 'If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and receive you to Myself, that where I am, [there] you may be also.
verses.textZh: 我若去為你們預備了地方，就必再來接你們到我那裡去，我在那裡，叫你們也在那裡。

verses.text: 'And you know the way where I am going.'
verses.textZh: 我往那裡去，你們知道；那條路，你們也知道（有古卷作：我往那裡去，你們知道那條路）。

verses.text: Thomas said to Him, 'Lord, we do not know where You are going, how do we know the way?'
verses.textZh: 多馬對他說：主阿，我們不知道你往那裡去，怎麼知道那條路呢？

verses.text: Jesus said to him, 'I am the way, and the truth, and the life; no one comes to the Father but through Me.
verses.textZh: 耶穌說我就是道路、真理、生命；若不藉著我，沒有人能到父那裡去。

verses.text: 'If you had known Me, you would have known My Father also; from now on you know Him, and have seen Him.'
verses.textZh: 你們若認識我，也就認識我的父。從今以後，你們認識他，並且已經看見他。

verses.text: Philip said to Him, 'Lord, show us the Father, and it is enough for us.'
verses.textZh: 腓力對他說：求主將父顯給我們看，我們就知足了。

verses.text: Jesus said to him, 'Have I been so long with you, and [yet] you have not come to know Me, Philip? He who has seen Me has seen the Father; how [can] you say, 'Show us the Father '?
verses.textZh: 耶穌對他說：腓力，我與你們同在這樣長久，你還不認識我麼？人看見了我，就是看見了父；你怎麼說將父顯給我們看呢？

verses.text: 'Do you not believe that I am in the Father, and the Father is in Me? The words that I say to you I do not speak on My own initiative, but the Father abiding in Me does His works.
verses.textZh: 我在父裡面，父在我裡面，你不信麼？我對你們所說的話，不是憑著自己說的，乃是住在我裡面的父做他自己的事。

verses.text: 'Believe Me that I am in the Father and the Father is in Me; otherwise believe because of the works themselves.
verses.textZh: 你們當信我，我在父裡面，父在我裡面；即或不信，也當因我所做的事信我。

verses.text: 'Truly, truly, I say to you, he who believes in Me, the works that I do, he will do also; and greater [works] than these he will do; because I go to the Father.
verses.textZh: 我實實在在的告訴你們，我所做的事，信我的人也要做，並且要做比這更大的事，因為我往父那裡去。

verses.text: 'Whatever you ask in My name, that will I do, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
verses.textZh: 你們奉我的名無論求甚麼，我必成就，叫父因兒子得榮耀。

verses.text: 'If you ask Me anything in My name, I will do [it].
verses.textZh: 你們若奉我的名求甚麼，我必成就。

verses.text: 'If you love Me, you will keep My commandments.
verses.textZh: 你們若愛我，就必遵守我的命令。

verses.text: 'I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Helper, that He may be with you forever;
verses.textZh: 我要求父，父就另外賜給你們一位保惠師（或作：訓慰師；下同），叫他永遠與你們同在，

verses.text: [that is] the Spirit of truth, whom the world cannot receive, because it does not see Him or know Him, [but] you know Him because He abides with you and will be in you.
verses.textZh: 就是真理的聖靈，乃世人不能接受的；因為不見他，也不認識他。你們卻認識他，因他常與你們同在，也要在你們裡面。

verses.text: 'I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you.
verses.textZh: 我不撇下你們為孤兒，我必到你們這裡來。

verses.text: 'After a little while the world will no longer see Me, but you [will] see Me; because I live, you will live also.
verses.textZh: 還有不多的時候，世人不再看見我，你們卻看見我；因為我活著，你們也要活著。

verses.text: 'In that day you will know that I am in My Father, and you in Me, and I in you.
verses.textZh: 到那日，你們就知道我在父裡面，你們在我裡面，我也在你們裡面。

verses.text: 'He who has My commandments and keeps them is the one who loves Me; and he who loves Me will be loved by My Father, and I will love him and will disclose Myself to him.'
verses.textZh: 有了我的命令又遵守的，這人就是愛我的；愛我的必蒙我父愛他，我也要愛他，並且要向他顯現。

verses.text: Judas (not Iscariot) said to Him, 'Lord, what then has happened that You are going to disclose Yourself to us and not to the world?'
verses.textZh: 猶大（不是加略人猶大）問耶穌說：主阿，為甚麼要向我們顯現，不向世人顯現呢？

verses.text: Jesus answered and said to him, 'If anyone loves Me, he will keep My word; and My Father will love him, and We will come to him and make Our abode with him.
verses.textZh: 耶穌回答說：人若愛我，就必遵守我的道；我父也必愛他，並且我們要到他那裡去，與他同住。

verses.text: 'He who does not love Me does not keep My words; and the word which you hear is not Mine, but the Father's who sent Me.
verses.textZh: 不愛我的人就不遵守我的道。你們所聽見的道不是我的，乃是差我來之父的道。

verses.text: 'These things I have spoken to you while abiding with you.
verses.textZh: 我還與你們同住的時候，已將這些話對你們說了。

verses.text: 'But the Helper, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in My name, He will teach you all things, and bring to your remembrance all that I said to you.
verses.textZh: 但保惠師，就是父因我的名所要差來的聖靈，他要將一切的事指教你們，並且要叫你們想起我對你們所說的一切話。

verses.text: 'Peace I leave with you; My peace I give to you; not as the world gives do I give to you. Do not let your heart be troubled, nor let it be fearful.
verses.textZh: 我留下平安給你們；我將我的平安賜給你們。我所賜的，不像世人所賜的。你們心裡不要憂愁，也不要膽怯。

verses.text: 'You heard that I said to you, 'I go away, and I will come to you.' If you loved Me, you would have rejoiced because I go to the Father, for the Father is greater than I.
verses.textZh: 你們聽見我對你們說了，我去還要到你們這裡來。你們若愛我，因我到父那裡去，就必喜樂，因為父是比我大的。

verses.text: 'Now I have told you before it happens, so that when it happens, you may believe.
verses.textZh: 現在事情還沒有成就，我預先告訴你們，叫你們到事情成就的時候就可以信。

verses.text: 'I will not speak much more with you, for the ruler of the world is coming, and he has nothing in Me;
verses.textZh: 以後我不再和你們多說話，因為這世界的王將到。他在我裡面是毫無所有；

verses.text: but so that the world may know that I love the Father, I do exactly as the Father commanded Me. Get up, let us go from here.
verses.textZh: 但要叫世人知道我愛父，並且父怎樣吩咐我，我就怎樣行。起來，我們走罷！
